what: A band across the photo (the original color layer) is tied to scroll: it enters from the top, rests at its spot (38% from the top edge) for a .2 share, then exits downward (.4 · .2 · .4). The image inside the band moves the opposite way, so it looks pinned to the photo with only the window passing by

options.hold: Share that stays in place (0~.9), default .2 — the rest is split evenly between entering and leaving
options.--fx-at: Where the band rests (% from the photo’s top edge, number only), default 38
options.--fx-band: Band height (% of photo height, number only), default 26

note: For the stuck poster (sticky), start: top 75%; end: bottom bottom — set to match the section length (Brand place poster)
